summary: Phase 0 Android-bundle split regression test on the PREVIEW (full web) environment where IS_USER_BUILD === false. Verified that the `{!IS_USER_BUILD && AdminLayout && (...)}` JSX wrapper at App.js:621 does NOT tree-shake AdminLayout / admin pages in the full web build, and that user-facing pages are unaffected. Backend /api/app/version-info was also verified to return v1.0.3 / code 4. ALL 5 review checks PASSED with zero JS runtime errors and zero 'rendered null component' errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1119 lines — exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline. The admin Routes block (lines 620-736) is ~115 lines of near-identical `<Route path=... element={canAccessAdmin(user) ? <Suspense><AdminLayout><Component/></AdminLayout></Suspense> : <Navigate to=/dashboard/>}/>` lines. Should be extracted into a helper like `adminRoute(path, Component)` to remove duplication and shrink the file. Functional correctness is fine — purely a maintainability nit.

Two endpoints return HTTP 403 silently in the user/admin dashboards (visible as `Failed to load resource: 403`). They don't break any flow but spam the console. Worth identifying which resource is 403'ing (likely an analytics ping or a feature-flag fetch) and either suppressing it for unauth states or removing the call.

AdminOnWebOnly.js auto-opens the browser inside useEffect on mount with no user gesture. On the web (non-Capacitor path), browsers commonly block programmatic `window.open` without a user gesture, so the auto-open will silently fail on the web — though that's OK because the screen also exposes an `Open Admin Panel in Browser` button. Not a bug in the Android (Capacitor) build, just a no-op on web.

(4) Logged-in regular user visiting /admin → instantly redirected to /dashboard (Navigate fallback because canAccessAdmin(user)===false). USER BUILD (REACT_APP_BUILD_TYPE=user) flow NOT exercised because the preview runs `yarn start` (dev mode, no build-type env). AdminOnWebOnly.js component code-reviewed only; its useEffect auto-opens window.open which is harmless on web (also has a manual button).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The critical guard `{!IS_USER_BUILD && AdminLayout && (...)}` correctly evaluates to truthy in the full web build (IS_USER_BUILD=false, AdminLayout=lazy reference), so all admin routes including the moved /admin/mall render with AdminLayout. canAccessAdmin(user) correctly returns false for regular user 9970100782 and true for admin@test.com, producing the expected redirect/render behavior.
